newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares advance on Creditanstalt gains.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares advance on Creditanstalt gains.

text.p: 1320 GMT - Austrian shares ended firmer on Wednesday after a weak opening. Creditanstalt preferred shares were the driving force behind the market, traders say. Next target seen 1,500 points.
* ATX up 12.02 points or 0.84 pct at 1,448.50
* Top gainer Creditanstalt preferred, up 9.40 pct at 619 schillings.
* Leading loser EA Generali, down 2.74 pct at 3,200 schillings.
* August ATX future up 16 points at 1,446.0
